shared_elements: large upright slab or block with a plain flat face
justification: A shows a distinct carved programme in low relief \u2014 a quadruped in profile with elongated body and legs, plus other animal/limb forms arranged in registers on the broad face of an upright slab \u2014 whereas B shows a masonry face with courses of blocks and no discernible depicted figures, symbols or ordered motifs at all. The only correspondence is the generic presence of large flat worked stone faces, which carries no iconographic weight.
